rules.items: Give every item a label, and an href unless it is the current page.
rules.current: The last item without an href (or explicitly marked current) renders as plain text with aria-current="page", never as a link to itself.

Breadcrumb.basic: <Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Inicio", href: "/" }, { label: "Reportes", href: "/reports" }, { label: "Ventas" }]} />
